ns2:course.label: Research on Teacher Education
ns2:course.description: (KINES 363) Critically examines theories, trends, problems, and implications of research on teacher education in Kinesiology. Students will complete a series of written assignments that are grounded in theory, illustrate critical thinking skills, and demonstrate knowledge of the literature. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: Junior, senior, or graduate standing.
